title: Introducing managed cluster extensions for observability and user management in Amazon SageMaker HyperPod Slurm
summary: Amazon SageMaker HyperPod now offers managed cluster extensions for observability and user management, bringing declarative, API- and console-driven configuration to the software running on Slurm cluster nodes. This post explains how the extensions work and follows a platform tea
